name: Hassan Sheikh Mohamud
summary: Mohamud advocates rebuilding Somali institutions, electoral democracy and international security partnerships against al-Shabaab. He links government to Islamic and Somali cultural principles while promoting regional trade, foreign investment, climate adaptation and nationally shared resource development.
